newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's keeps Showa Denko Ba3 debt rating.
newsitem.headline: Moody's keeps Showa Denko Ba3 debt rating.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Thursday that it has decided to maintain its rating of Ba3 for Showa Denko KK's long-term debt.
The rating outlook remains negative, the credit rating firm also said.
Moody's said it kept its rating for Showa Denko due to its expectation that the company's earnings would improve due to progress in diversifying into new business areas and emerging markets in Asia.
The debt securities confirmed are Showa Denko's 10 billion yen 1.7 percent convertible bonds due 2002 and 30 billion yen 1.7 percent convertible bonds due 2005, Moody's said.
